limits: Human-readable mode labels require the separately reviewed exact-product vendor protocol; the EC table has numeric selectors only.

razerAcpiDxe.conclusion: Bounded recovered helper reads EC data into NVS; no dynamic CPU temperature reader or _TMP patch established.

ecDefinitions.architecture: RISC-V RV32 with compressed instructions; coherent reset, interrupt and ordinary code recovered.
ecDefinitions.addressConvention: Runtime code addresses use the 0x80000000 flash mapping; subtract that base for image offsets. RAM/MMIO addresses are explicit operand-derived addresses. No 0581 code/table offsets were transferred.

loadMap.caveat: RAM regions describe actual operand ranges, not independently verified physical aliasing.

bankMap.format: little-endian uint32 metadata, uint32 target pointer
bankMap.writeExclusion: metadata byte equal to 1 is skipped; table entries 2 pass. The handler does not validate a feature-specific typed operation.

smbus.readCaveat: Instructions write mapped data then zero to the data register; pseudocode omits the first store. Bus latch timing and live transactions were not tested.
smbus.narrowWriteExclusion: The separate index0x36/manual-bit 7 gate derives from next-index comparison0x37 at0x80001ac2..0x80001ada; other listed writes still require their own host admission.

mailbox.bounds: bank<=7; length<=32; index addition wraps to8bits
mailbox.statusCaveat: Sets0x80 before the mapped loop. Skipped read-only descriptors can still return that transfer status; this is not feature readback.

normalThermal.admission: RAM0x84ee3 bit 0 gates this policy. Selectors0..7 follow normal path;08..FD return after separateFE/FF branches.
normalThermal.loadCaveat: Checks persistent record metadata/checksum and may seed defaults; no active table was read.
normalThermal.productCapCaveat: OpenBlade retains its separately established5000RPM cap for0528. Image defaults do not expand host authority or establish effective RPM.

customPerformance.firstSelectorEffect: Selects a policy index, with concrete0/1/2 branches and policy-condition variants;19-byte record fromRAM0x86d00+index*0x13 is copied intoRAM0x86fe8 at0x80014648..0x8001465e.
customPerformance.secondSelectorEffect: Feeds distinct computation 0x80009e34, including0/1/other branches for mode4; updates request/config bytes0x86ff4/0x86ff6/0x86ff9/0x86ffa under board/power gates.
customPerformance.labelBasis: CPU/GPU labels belong to the separately reviewed host vendor contract; firmware proves distinct selectors and their consumers here.
customPerformance.limits: No exact live CPU wattage, maximum frequency or GPU TGP established; complete02C6 MCU HID-to-EC translation remains untraced.

chargeField.encoding: bit 7 enables a low 7-bit numeric ceiling; high byte0x808ef is inhibit latch

powerFlags.writeContract: A mapped write replaces the entire byte; no implicit bit preservation.

chargeAndPowerMode.hysteresis: Under existing charger gates: latch when Rsoc>=ceiling; clear when Rsoc<ceiling-5 (or ceiling<=5).
chargeAndPowerMode.chargeInhibitOutput: RAM0x84e3c=0 andRAM0x84ea2 bit 3 set at0x8000cc4a..0x8000cc5e when enabled+latch and no bypass.
chargeAndPowerMode.temporaryFullCharge: Powerflagsbit 2 bypasses the ceiling inhibit at0x8000cc40..0x8000cc48.
chargeAndPowerMode.configurationMirrors: Handler copies0x808ee low byte toRAM0x86055 andpowerflagsbit 2 toRAM0x8605a bit 0, markingRAM0x8091c bit 0. This is not a reviewed durable write/restoration contract.
chargeAndPowerMode.maximumFans: Powerflagsbit 1 participates in Custommode4 fan handling0x8001447e, including an internal5500RPM target literal, plus GPU policy branches0x80009e34. This is not an effective tach or new host range.
chargeAndPowerMode.unresolvedBits: CPU boostbit 0 andlocal dimmingbit 3 meanings were not independently completed from this EC; retain reviewed vendor host contract and whole-byte safeguards.
chargeAndPowerMode.limits: No live charge transition, current measurement, ceiling range/step admission or complete07/0f HID translation tested/recovered.

versionPublication.limits: Publishes a firmware-owned version representation; does not prove running-device identity or Windows firmware-metadata equivalence.

analysisLimitations: Compiler save/restore helpers useJALt0/nonstandard return; recovered pseudocode has extraout and jump-table artifacts. Conclusions above were checked against explicit instructions and image descriptors.
No vendor debug symbols, execution, active-state reads or physical validation.
EC SMBus/mailbox ingress is established. The normal 02C6 MCU translation of HID 0D/01,0D/02,07/12 and07/0F remains a separate missing link.

limits: The exact 0528 image independently establishes banked EC ingress, normal thermal policy and distinct Custom selectors; no 0581 offsets were reused.
Factory manual maximum 5100 differs from the separately admitted OpenBlade 5000 cap; no runtime range change is proposed.
Battery ceiling and PowerModebits1/2 have selectedEC consumers; bits0/3 and completeHID translation are unproven here.
BIOS thermal-zone path exists but literal_TMP cannot establish live CPU temperature.
No physical command submission, active table read, charge/fan response or durable restoration verified.

methods: SHA-256 and Windows Authenticode over outer carriers; no carrier execution.
Raw NSIS blocks decompressed with Python standard-library LZMA; offsets are file offsets of the four-byte stored-length field.
0528 BIOS parsed with existing UEFIExtract NE alpha74; flat short-path extraction completed successfully with a last-VTF-in-compressed-item warning.
ACPI tables selected by signature, bounded declared length and checksum; exact DSDT disassembled using ACPICA iASL20250807 without evaluating methods.
0581 factory tables independently redecoded from the pinned EC image; selected retained NDS32 instruction listings inspected.
0528 RazerAcpiDxe parsed with existing Ghidra12.1.3 x86-64; recovered C is pseudocode, not vendor source.
0528 follow-up independently recovered RISC-V startup/flash mapping, IRQ+banked ingress and selected state consumers; data-only decoder checked 32 factory tables and 344 stages and 8 bank pointers.
conclusions: Retain exact-model runtime support and existing physical-validation records unchanged.
Firmware images corroborate selected semantics, not complete command admission or physical success.

Both constant-backed paths are removed by the accompanying shared telemetry fix; no replacement sensor, numeric blacklist or physical-temperature claim. Existing custom-curve null-CPU fallback requests the exact model maximum.
